_meta.purpose: Routing regression: does the model name the dashboard definition a question is about, compose only when no tile fits, and decline what it must not guess? Run with `npm run eval -- --routing`.
_meta.why: The counting regex and word matcher were replaced by the model's own judgement on 2026-09-30. A word matcher fails visibly; a model picks the wrong tile quietly. This fixture is the guard.
_meta.scoring: shouldPick passes when the reply is DEFINITION with the expected id, and with the expected group when one is given. shouldCompose passes when the reply is METRIC on the expected table (not a DEFINITION). shouldDecline passes when the reply is NO_ANSWER of any type.
